responsibility: Implements the gcov-dump standalone debugging utility that parses gcno/gcda files and prints their raw record structure. It opens gcov files through gcov-io, decodes top-level tags such as function, blocks, arcs, lines, counters, and summaries, optionally dumps record positions and contents, and provides a stable sorted presentation for TOPN/indirect-call counters to support comparisons. Its role is inspection of gcov file format data rather than compilation or report generation.
